title: Monorepo Cleanup: Babyproofing for Subagents
description:
Monorepo cleanup and restructuring for subagent comprehension.

Goals:
1. Archive old/deprecated projects (ada-mcp-old, ada-craft, loose files)
2. Clean up root directory cruft (test outputs, temp files, logs)
3. Add hierarchical .ai/ folders to each active project
4. Update root .ai/ to be an index/conventions hub
5. Ensure each project has clear README and machine docs
6. Make workspace navigable for subagents

Active projects to keep:
- archangel/ (main focus)
- ada-mcp/ (our tools)
- ada-slm/ (training)
- ada-sif/ (SIF toolkit)
- brain/ (core API)
- Ada-Consciousness-Research/ (research vault)

Approach: Go folder by folder, create sub-beads as needed.

title: Implement ACP-based subagent spawning in ada-mcp
description:
Replace shell-based opencode_spawn with proper ACP (Agent Client Protocol) integration:

1. Add agent-client-protocol dependency to ada-mcp
2. Create ACP client class that handles:
   - Spawning OpenCode in ACP mode (opencode acp)
   - Session management
   - Streaming responses back
   - Tool call handling
3. Update opencode_spawn tool to use ACP
4. Add new tools:
   - opencode_spawn_acp: Spawn and get session ID
   - opencode_prompt: Send prompt to existing session
   - opencode_status: Check agent status
   - opencode_stop: Terminate agent session

Reference: Ada-Consciousness-Research/external/acp-python-sdk/examples/client.py

This enables true swarm orchestration from within ada-mcp!

title: Daemon architecture split - separate state from GUI
description: Split neko into daemon (state/logic) and client (GUI rendering). Daemon manages pet state, multi-pet coordination, and external integrations. Client connects via Unix socket and handles rendering only. This enables notification integration, LLM features, and cellular automata.

title: Create neko-daemon with socket IPC
description: Create neko-daemon crate with Unix domain socket IPC. Daemon manages pet state, behavior logic, and DSL runtime. Define protocol for client-daemon communication (cursor position, pet state updates, sprite requests).

title: Refactor neko-wayland into thin client
description: Refactor neko-wayland into thin GUI client. Remove state management and behavior logic. Client only handles: Wayland layer-shell, sprite rendering, cursor position reporting to daemon, receiving pet state updates from daemon.

title: Migrate behavior logic to daemon
description: Migrate DSL runtime, behavior state machine, and pet logic from neko-wayland to neko-daemon. Daemon becomes the source of truth for all pet state. Test that classic_neko.neko still works with new architecture.

title: Chat bubbles - pets can say things!
description: Add speech/thought bubbles to pets! DSL gets 'say' action with text, duration, and bubble style (speech/thought). Support 'command:' field to pipe from external commands like fortune. Render bubbles in Cairo with proper positioning and styling.

title: DSL say action and command execution
description: Add 'say' action to DSL with fields: text (string or command output), duration (timeout), bubble_style (speech/thought). Update parser and runtime to handle say states. Daemon executes commands and sends text to client for rendering.

title: Cairo bubble rendering
description: Render speech and thought bubbles in Cairo. Speech bubble: rounded rectangle with tail pointing to pet. Thought bubble: cloud shape with small circles. Auto-wrap text, position above pet, handle screen edge cases.

title: Multi-pet interactions and cellular automata
description: Support multiple pet instances with inter-pet interactions! Add pet_near trigger, spawn/despawn actions, and cellular automata rules. Enables blob colonies, pet play interactions, and emergent behaviors.

title: pet_near trigger for proximity detection
description: Add pet_near(distance, type: optional) trigger to DSL. Daemon tracks all pet positions and checks proximity. Trigger fires when another pet is within range. Optional type filter for specific pet types.

title: spawn/despawn actions for pet lifecycle
description: Add spawn and despawn actions to DSL. spawn: creates new pet instance of specified type. despawn: removes current pet. Daemon manages pet lifecycle and notifies clients of new/removed pets.

title: Cellular automata rules engine
description: Add cellular_automata: true flag to DSL. Implement simple CA rules (Conway's Game of Life, Lenia-inspired). Pets can have reproduction rules, death conditions, and emergent behaviors. Create blob_colony.neko example.

title: Movement behavior modes (chase/wander/mixed)
description: Implement behavior modes: 1) Chase cursor constantly, 2) Wander randomly, 3) Mixed mode (wander, notice cursor, chase, lose interest, wander again). State machine with transitions.

title: D-Bus notification integration
description: Daemon listens to D-Bus notifications and triggers pet reactions! Add listen_dbus: true flag to DSL. Add 'notification' trigger that fires on new notifications. Pet can display notification content in speech bubbles. Could replace mako entirely!

title: D-Bus notification listener
description: Add D-Bus listener to daemon using zbus crate. Listen for org.freedesktop.Notifications signals. Parse notification summary, body, app_name. Trigger 'notification' event in DSL runtime with notification data.

title: LLM integration for dynamic responses
description: Add LLM integration to daemon for generating dynamic pet responses! Support local models (via ollama/llama.cpp) and API endpoints. Add 'llm_prompt' field to say action. Pet can generate contextual responses based on notifications, time of day, or random musings.

title: OpenCode session management - tmux-style persistence
description: Improve opencode_spawn to work like tmux - keep sessions alive, return session IDs, add tool to check session output later. Use send_message_async for long-running tasks, add get_session_output tool to retrieve results. Store session metadata in ~/.ada/opencode_sessions.json for persistence.

title: Sprite sheet loading and rendering
description: Load and render actual neko sprite sheets instead of placeholder cat face. Support classic 32x32 neko format with 8-directional running, idle animations, sleep states.

title: Configuration file support
description: TOML config file for: sprite sheet path, behavior mode, speed, idle timeout, screen bounds, etc. XDG config location (~/.config/neko-wayland/config.toml)

title: Transparent window background
description: Make window background transparent so only the cat sprite is visible, not the tan background square.

title: Kitty Behavior DSL for configurable algorithms
description: Create a small domain-specific language for describing cat behavior algorithms. Should support composable states (wander, chase, alert, sleep, lose_interest), configurable transitions (on cursor_near, on timeout, on idle), movement interpolation (linear, ease_in_out, bezier), and tunable parameters (speed, attention span, detection radius). Potential crossover with AGL stateful behavior graphs. Load via --algo flag or config file.

title: Refactor: Create unified config module
description: Create src/config.rs with unified Config struct that supports both CLI args and config file loading. Use serde for TOML/JSON. Config file at ~/.config/neko-wayland/config.toml. CLI args override config file values.

title: Refactor: Split main.rs into modules
description: Break main.rs into app.rs (application setup), ui.rs (drawing logic), and pet.rs (behavior coordinator). Keep main.rs minimal - just CLI and app launch.

title: Refactor: Create unified sprite abstraction
description: Create sprite_loader.rs with unified SpriteSource enum (Cairo/SpriteSheet/VPet). Implement common interface for dimensions() and draw(). Simplifies sprite handling across the codebase.
